body:
Sibling of #2255 (fixed in 7a3fed6bb for Sink).

`affinityFor` in internal/gateway/gateway.go (~line 1837) reads `Affinity` and `Rotate` only from the group the agent named (`g.Affinity`, `g.Routing == provider.Rotate`, scope `group:<id>`). A group nested inside it has its own Affinity setting in the editor (`provider.Group.Affinity`), but nothing reads it. A nested group set to `off` or `strict` gets the outer group's behaviour instead.

To do:
- Decide what a nested group's Affinity means: its own scope, or a mode for the members it contributes.
- Apply it, or hide the setting on a group used as a member.
- Add a test that fails on the current code.
title: gateway: a group in the group's Affinity is never read — only the group the agent named keeps a conversation on its key
